mapper.select: SELECT * FROM price_sample_batch WHERE source_kind=#{kind} AND source_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_sample(id,batch_id,row_number,original) SELECT x.id,#{batch},x.number,x.original FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{rows} AS jsonb)) AS x(id uuid,number integer,original jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM price_sample WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM price_brand WHERE name=#{name} AND enabled ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
SELECT id FROM price_model WHERE brand_id=#{brand} AND code='HIST-UNSPECIFIED' AND enabled
SELECT id FROM price_part WHERE name=#{name} AND unit=#{unit} AND enabled ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
mapper.update: UPDATE price_sample SET revision=revision+1 WHERE batch_id=#{batch} AND revision=0
mapper.sql: FROM price_sample s JOIN price_sample_batch b ON b.id=s.batch_id LEFT JOIN price_sample_review r ON r.sample_id=s.id AND r.revision=s.revision LEFT JOIN price_part p ON p.id=r.part_id LEFT JOIN price_model m ON m.id=r.model_id LEFT JOIN price_brand brand ON brand.id=m.brand_id

where.if: AND s.created_at>=(CAST(#{f.from} AS date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
AND s.created_at<((CAST(#{f.to} AS date)+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
AND r.unit=#{f.unit} AND r.part_brand=coalesce(#{f.partBrand},'') AND r.region=coalesce(#{f.region},'')

mapper.sql: jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'batchId',b.id,'sourceKind',b.source_kind,'fileName',b.file_name, 'hasFile',b.object_key IS NOT NULL,'original',s.original-'quality'-'priceDate','version',s.revision,'status',coalesce(r.status,'PENDING'), 'partId',r.part_id,'partName',p.name,'modelId',r.model_id,'modelName',m.name,'vehicleBrand',brand.name, 'amount',r.amount::text,'unit',r.unit,'partBrand',r.part_brand,'region',r.region, 'importedDate',(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, 'priceNature',r.price_nature,'reason',coalesce(r.reason,'请核对车型、配件、单位及价格性质'))::text
mapper.select: SELECT JOIN price_sample origin ON origin.id=#{id} AND origin.batch_id=s.batch_id AND origin.original->>'historicalCaseId'=s.original->>'historicalCaseId' AND origin.original->>'lineNumber'=s.original->>'lineNumber' WHERE b.source_kind='HISTORICAL_ARCHIVE' AND r.status='CONFIRMED' AND r.price_nature IN ('SUPPLIER_QUOTED','CP_QUOTED') ORDER BY r.price_nature DESC,s.id LIMIT 2
SELECT ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql:
SELECT r.part_id,r.model_id,p.name part_name,m.name model_name,brand.name vehicle_brand, r.unit,r.part_brand,r.region,r.price_nature,count(*) records,min(r.amount)::text minimum, max(r.amount)::text maximum,(max(s.created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date latest
GROUP BY r.part_id,r.model_id,p.name,m.name,brand.name,r.unit,r.part_brand,r.region,r.price_nature
mapper.select: SELECT to_jsonb(g)::text FROM () g ORDER BY latest DESC,part_id,model_id,unit,part_brand,region,price_nature LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM price_sample_review WHERE sample_id=#{id}
SELECT (to_jsonb(r)-'quality'-'price_date'||jsonb_build_object('amount',r.amount::text))::text FROM price_sample_review r WHERE sample_id=#{id} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM price_part_model pm JOIN price_part p ON p.id=pm.part_id JOIN price_model m ON m.id=pm.model_id JOIN price_brand b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE pm.part_id=#{part} AND pm.model_id=#{model} AND p.enabled AND m.enabled AND b.enabled AND p.unit=#{unit})
mapper.update: UPDATE price_sample SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id}
